name: Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes for ML (Terraform / K8s)
description: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes cluster architecture for ML (EKS/GKE), Karpenter node provisioning, GPU device plugins, IAM roles & service accounts, and cluster networking.

subskills.name: Terraform Modules for ML Platforms
subskills.description: Authoring modular Terraform for ML: EKS/GKE clusters, S3/GCS model artifact buckets, IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA), and MLflow DBs.

subskills.name: NVIDIA GPU Device Plugin & Operator for K8s
subskills.description: Installing NVIDIA GPU Operator on Kubernetes, nvidia-device-plugin DaemonSet, automatic driver injection, and GPU node tagging.

subskills.name: Karpenter Just-in-Time GPU Node Provisioning
subskills.description: Configuring Karpenter NodePools and EC2NodeClasses for fast, dynamic GPU instance provisioning (g5, p4d) directly from pending pod specs.

subskills.name: IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA / Workload Identity)
subskills.description: Binding Kubernetes ServiceAccounts to AWS IAM roles / GCP Workload Identity to grant least privilege S3/GCS bucket access without hardcoded keys.

subskills.name: Helm Charts for MLOps Tooling Deployments
subskills.description: Deploying and managing MLOps platform components (MLflow, Feast, KServe, Prometheus) using custom and community Helm charts.

subskills.name: Cluster Ingress, TLS Termination & cert-manager
subskills.description: Configuring Ingress-NGINX / Envoy Gateway, Let's Encrypt TLS certificates with cert-manager, and secure external domain routing.

subskills.name: High-Throughput Storage (EFS, FSx for Lustre, NVMe)
subskills.description: Mounting high-throughput shared storage (Amazon FSx for Lustre, EFS, local NVMe CSI) to pods for multi-gigabyte model checkpoint loading.

subskills.name: Multi-Tenant Resource Quotas & NetworkPolicies
subskills.description: Hard multi-tenancy in ML clusters: ResourceQuotas, LimitRanges per team namespace, NetworkPolicies for traffic isolation, and priority classes.

subskills.name: Multi-Region Cloud Failover & Disaster Recovery
subskills.description: Cross-region S3 replication of model registries, multi-region Route 53 DNS failover, and automated cluster disaster recovery runbooks.

cv.signal: Provisioned multi-cluster Kubernetes ML platform using Terraform, Karpenter GPU autoscaling, and FSx for Lustre

linkedin.signal: Kubernetes for ML, Terraform, and Cloud Infrastructure endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes for ML Technical Assessment

junior.description: Deploys NVIDIA GPU device plugins, configures least-privilege IRSA security, and manages Helm chart releases.

mid.description: Provisions ML clusters with Terraform, mounts high-speed FSx/NVMe volumes, configures TLS cert-manager, and enforces namespace quotas.

senior.description: Architects just-in-time GPU node provisioning with Karpenter and implements enterprise multi-region cloud disaster recovery.
